Guidance & outlook: We have been working on this since almost a year where we got one order of $12 million there where we are designing from scratch, starting from 1 kV, 2 kV, 3 kV with battery, without battery and that company where we are as of now going with three variants, six SKUs of it and probably down the line, we are expecting to go more.
If you go, let's see, if I say our next year will be around ₹550 crores to ₹600 crores, then everybody will be happy.
But right now, my goal is, let's see, if I give you ₹550 crores to ₹600 crores for end of next year, I think you'll be happy and your math will fit in that.
Growth & demand: And if you look at our open order book and pipeline right now is almost $70 to $80 million just worth of pipeline we have.
That's the growth we are eyeing on, 40% to 50% because we are seeing the open order book.

So, any specific percentage you would like to guide or comment upon from the organic growth point of view because those numbers are not reconciling because like he was also quoting 40%, 50% growth with the current order [Voice Inaudible] [0:43:06] and second there would be any organic growth from Aimtron Electronics.
Margins & costs: For H2 2026, Aimtron Electronics reported consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,786 million and EBITDA was ₹369 million and profit after tax was ₹257 million.
So due to that, we are seeing some impact on the EBITDA margins on consolidated levels around 22%, 22.5%.
So if I heard it correctly, the ICS or AIC is doing 11% margins as of now on EBITDA level.
Capex & expansion: You see that we have already acquired a company in Decatur, Illinois, and building a deeper customer relationship like a stickiness of the customer and creating a more professional, scalable, and future-ready organisation.

So, we are in like manufacturing facilities in Gujarat VadodaraOne is in U.S., which we recently acquired one company that is renamed as Aimtron International Controls and we do have our presence in Bangalore as well.
Akshay, ₹16.8 crores is given to Aimtron LLC in Texas, Aimtron Electronics LLC in Texas to acquisition.
Balance sheet & cash: So, we have generated ₹40 crores negative cash flow this financial year.
Ma'am, I am referring to the consolidated cash flow at one line item is the ₹16.8 crores of the loans and advances.
And we have around ₹240 crores of inventory of money locked in inventory and receivables.
Risks & challenges: So this is like more often solutions that we provide, product engineering solutions, PES we call, so that includes like hardware, software, firmware, mechanical.
So, we do have like a design team in-house where we have hardware, software, firmware, mechanical everything.
So as Sneh said, mainly supply chain, but we are communicating with the customers and make sure, I think that's what the main we see the mitigation for risk.

guidance.t: Certainly, like, so if we combine all group of companies, probably we stand at somewhere around ₹600 crores kind of an open order book that includes Aimtron India as well as AIC in total.
